label: iec104-server
info:
IEC 60870-5-104 SCADA Server Flow (FR48) + Command Bridge (Story 2.4)

Runs an external json-iec104-server binary via daemon node to provide IEC104 server functionality for grid operator (EVN) connections.

Inputs:
- IEC-Server-In (link in) — control commands from other flows
- nexus/+/+/telemetry — latest inverter telemetry for IEC104 responses
- nexus/internal/writeback-status — Modbus write confirmation (Story 2.4)
- nexus/internal/writeback-errors — Modbus write failure (Story 2.4)

Outputs:
- IEC-Server-Out (link out) — parsed IEC104 data to other flows
- nexus/internal/iec104-status — connection status (retained)
- nexus/internal/iec104-command — control commands from grid operator (includes event_id for audit)
- nexus/internal/iec104-errors — error reporting
- nexus/internal/command-audit — command lifecycle audit trail (Story 2.4)

Protocol: IEC 60870-5-104 (TCP port 2404)
Role: Controlled station (server) — EVN connects as controlling station (client)

Command Bridge (Story 2.4):
- Subscribes to writeback-status/errors from Modbus write-back flow
- Converts write confirmations into IEC104 ack (C_SE_NC_1, COT=7) sent back to grid operator
- Converts write failures into IEC104 nack (C_SE_NC_1, COT=47) sent back to grid operator
- Publishes command lifecycle audit trail to nexus/internal/command-audit

name: Flow: iec104-server (FR48) + Command Bridge (Story 2.4)
info:
IEC 60870-5-104 SCADA Server Flow

Purpose: Provide IEC104 server for grid operator to monitor and control solar inverters.

Architecture:
- External binary (json-iec104-server) managed by daemon node
- Communication via stdin/stdout with newline-delimited JSON
- Connection status published to MQTT for gateway health integration
- Control commands forwarded to MQTT for Modbus write-back (Story 2.2)
- Write confirmations/errors flow back from Modbus to IEC104 for grid operator acknowledgment (Story 2.4)

IOA Mapping:
- IOA 1: power_draw_kw (M_ME_NC_1, float)
- IOA 2: export_limit_kw (M_ME_NC_1, float)
- IOA 3: inverter_status (M_SP_NA_1, boolean)

Reverse IOA Mapping (action → IOA for ack/nack):
- set_power_draw_kw → IOA 1
- set_export_limit_kw → IOA 2
- set_inverter_status → IOA 3

Error handling: catch node logs all errors via nexus/internal/iec104-errors
